mentions.name: AuditBadger
mentions.description: A compliance management platform for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 where AI drafts policies, controls, risks, and business continuity plans, with humans always in the loop since every output requires sign-off. Asset management features are being revamped to fully support NIS2.
mentions.problem: Making fellow founders' lives easier when it comes to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance, while avoiding fully hands-off "we do compliance for you" or "AI can do compliance for you" approaches.
mentions.audience: Founders dealing with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance
mentions.source_excerpt: AuditBadger (https://auditbadger.com) is a compliance management platform where AI drafts policies, controls, risks, business continuity plans, and so on. Humans are always in the loop; everything needs to be signed off
